item.title: The rogue-lite VR game, Street Gods, is now available on Meta Quest
item.description: "Soul Assembly today launches Street Gods, a high-impact VR rogue-lite that puts players in control of divine power as they wield the legendary hammer Mjolnir against a city on the brink of Ragnarök. Available now on Meta Quest 3 and 3S." - Soul Assembly.

item.title: The mysterious visual novel and Roger just won the Emotional Impact Award
item.description: "and Roger, the mysterious point-and-click slice-of-life visual novel developed by TearyHand Studio and published by Kodansha Creators Lab that launched earlier this year on PC via Steam and Nintendo Switch, won the Emotional Impact Award at Six One Indies Indie Game Awards today." - TearyHand Studio and Kodansha Creators Lab.

item.title: Vince Zampella, video game developer behind 'Call of Duty' franchise, killed in mountain road crash
item.description: Vince Zampella is the former CEO of video game developers Infinity Ward, the studio behind the wildly successful "Call of Duty" franchise.
